topic: Unsubscribing from marketing emails to kill impulse-buy temptation (Flint vs Vesper)

scenes.narration: The average shopper gets over one hundred tempting sale emails every single month. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym buried under flying SALE email envelopes, comic burst banner reads ONE HUNDRED A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Flint and Vesper both drown in daily promo email blasts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man flint and woman vesper in gym gear swamped by phone notifications labeled PROMO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every flash sale and coupon lands right in their inbox.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two phones on a gym bench showing inboxes stamped FLASH SALE and COUPON, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Flint keeps opening every subject line screaming twenty percent off.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, flint on a gym mat tapping his phone, an email banner stamped TWENTY PERCENT OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each tempting email nudges him toward another impulse buy he regrets.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, flint surrounded by shopping bags near a gym locker, comic banner reads IMPULSE BUY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vesper spends one afternoon unsubscribing from every marketing email sender.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vesper on a gym mat tapping UNSUBSCRIBE buttons on a phone, a checklist labeled CLEAN INBOX, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Now no sale alerts reach her phone or her inbox.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vesper holding a calm empty phone inbox in the gym, a screen stamped NO ALERTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Out of sight, those manufactured shopping urges simply stop appearing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vesper calmly stretching in the gym, a faded shopping cart icon stamped NO URGES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Flint impulse-bought over eight hundred dollars extra.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked flint on a gym bench under a pile of packages stamped EIGHT HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vesper's impulse spending dropped to almost nothing across the whole year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vesper pointing at a gym wall chart with a falling line labeled IMPULSE SPENDING DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She still shops, but only when she actually needs something.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vesper calmly checking one item off a short list near a gym bench labeled NEEDS ONLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Unsubscribe from marketing emails and remove the temptation entirely. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading UNSUBSCRIBE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
